info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Webhooks-v2-spec
info.description: The Payment Webhooks API allows consumers to receive real-time notifications about payment events. This includes updates on payment status changes, which can significantly enhance the responsiveness of payment processing applications. Ideal for developers looking to integrate seamless payment tracking into their systems, this API provides a reliable way to manage and respond to various payment activities. Use cases include automating order fulfillment, updating customer records, and notifying users through third-party applications.

get.description: This endpoint is designed to handle webhook requests from payment providers, allowing you to receive and process payment notifications securely and efficiently.

requestBody.description: The request body for the webhook endpoint, which should contain relevant details about the payment event.

ListPaymentsPaymentsWebhooksRequest.description: The request body for the GET webhook operations for payments. It contains a string payload that may include various parameters relevant to the webhook.
